articles.summary: Great Falls, Montana – KRTV, the CBS affiliate in Great Falls, Montana, owned by The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP), has earned a 2026 National Edward R. Murrow Award in the category of “Excellence in Innovation” for its special report, “Milk River Meltdown.”
articles.title: Scripps’ KRTV wins National Murrow Award for ‘Excellence in Innovation’

articles.summary: PHOENIX (August 14, 2026) – Position Sports and The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) are partnering to present the inaugural Scripps Sports Women’s Basketball Showcase, a new premier women’s college basketball event debuting on Wednesday, December 16, at Mortgage Matchup Center in Phoenix.
articles.title: INAUGURAL SCRIPPS SPORTS WOMEN’S BASKETBALL SHOWCASE HEADED TO MORTGAGE MATCHUP CENTER ON DECEMBER 16

articles.summary: CINCINNATI – The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) delivered $490 million in revenue for the second quarter of 2026. Loss attributable to the shareholders of Scripps was $1.2 billion or $12.68 per share. A non-cash goodwill and other intangible assets impairment charge for the quarter accounted for $11.61 of the per-share loss.
articles.title: Scripps reports Q2 2026 financial results

articles.summary: The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) has completed its previously announced acquisition of WTVQ, the ABC affiliate in Lexington, Kentucky, from Morris Network, Inc. for $15.8 million.
articles.title: Scripps completes acquisition of WTVQ in Lexington
